text:
sienna: Heads up, moving out on Friday. Free curbside pickup: solid oak 5-shelf bookcase (~72in x 30in), super sturdy but heavy, and 2 SF Giants tickets (sec 118). Photos: https://imgur.com/a/example

morgan: omg that bookcase is my dream. any dings? does it come apart? :eyes: 

sienna: shelves are removable, no major damage just a small scuff on one corner. needs two people to move.

ben: i9ll take the tickets if still available. when9s the game?

sienna: june 10th, 7pm. first DM gets them.

alex: i can pick up the bookcase. have a buddy with a van and a dolly. fri morning works.

jules: happy to help with stairs/carrying, i live 2 blocks away in soma.

morgan: tagging @alex re: fit in stairwell — might need to tilt but should be fine if shelves come out.

alex: thanks @morgan. @sienna what time friday is best? i can do 9:30-11am or after 5pm.

sienna: 9:30am Friday is perfect. address: 456 3rd St (SOMA), loading dock C. i'll leave a note on the door.

office-bot: Calendar event created: "Pickup - Oak Bookcase" Fri 9:30am 9 2 attendees.

ben: tickets please! DMing now for transfer. :baseball:

sienna: tickets reserved for ben, bookcase reserved for alex + jules. if plans change i'll update. thank you all for being quick!

morgan: yay recycling > landfill. post a pic after the move? :heart:

sienna: will do. probably a pic of the empty apartment and a triumphant selfie at the game if ben remembers to send one. :)
